documents.title: Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) Revised For 30Th September 2026
The Interim Dividend Shall Be Payable To The Shareholders Whose Names Appear In The Register Of Members Of The Company As On The Record Date, I.E., Friday, November 20, 2026.

analysis.summary: Marsons reported its Q3 and 9M FY25 investor presentation highlighting its capabilities in power and distribution transformers, manufacturing infrastructure, and financial performance. Management noted ongoing expansion into renewable energy application transformers and international markets including the UK and EU. The company also detailed various industry growth drivers such as transmission capex, solar installations, and data center demand. Financial highlights showed total income of Rs. 4,654.09 lakhs and a PAT of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Transformer requirements are expected to almost double due to transmission grid strengthening.
demand_outlook.quote: Transformer Requirements To Almost Double On The Back Of Transmission Grid Strengthening

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for the company's products is expected to grow significantly due to government thrust on power generation and transmission, grid strengthening, and renewable energy capacity growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for the Company’s products is expected to grow significantly in the coming years, driven by the Government’s continued thrust on power generation and transmission capacity addition, grid strengthening, and rapid growth in renewable energy capacity including solar and wind, which require substantial new transformer and substation infrastructure for evacuation and grid integration.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established a UK-based subsidiary to serve as a strategic hub across the UK and Europe, operational in H1 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: Established a UK-based subsidiary to serve as a strategic hub across UK & Europe.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand footprints organically as well as inorganically for exports.
capex_expansion.quote: We plan to expand footprints organically as well as inorganically.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity is projected to increase from 4,500 MVA in FY25 to 9,000 MVA in FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margins in exports are accretive in nature.
margins_costs.quote: Since margins in exports are accretive in nature.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed manufacturing capacity stands at 4,500 MVA in FY25 with a 30% utilization rate.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not transferred any amount to reserves during FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company has not transferred any amount to reserves during FY 2025-26.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that forward-looking statements are subject to risks including fluctuations in earnings, competition, economic growth, and government policies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The risks and uncertainties relating to these statements include, but are not limited to, risks and uncertainties regarding fluctuations in earnings, our ability to manage growth, competition (both domestic and international), economic growth in India and abroad, ability to attract and retain highly skilled professionals, time and cost over runs on contracts, our ability to manage our international operations, government policies and actions regulations, interest and other fiscal costs generally prevailing in the economy.

risks_headwinds.claim: The nature of the company's business is capital intensive, where any cycle delay causes huge interest loss and impacts the bottom line.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company’s nature of business is capital intensive and hence any delay in cycle causes huge interest loss and marks the bottom line of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Threats exist from unorganized small scale entrepreneurs who sometimes take large orders due to their small set up costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The threat is also from unorganized small scale entrepreneurs who sometimes run away with big orders due to their small set up cost.

management_commitments.claim: The UK subsidiary is scheduled to be operational in H1 FY26.
management_commitments.quote: Subsidiary to be operational in H1 FY26, positioning us to capitalize on growing demand efficiently.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand its export footprints organically as well as inorganically, with prototype building currently in place.
management_commitments.quote: Our prototype building is currently in place. We plan to expand footprints organically as well as inorganically.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
